title: Interruptible hotpatch and cross-env escalation procedure for model rollout regressions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: During a staggered model rollout of v3.1 for the long-context summarization family, multiple customers reported semantic regressions and hallucinations. The failure surface differs by deployment mode: Hosted traffic degraded selectively for <100ms requests (mitigated by routing), Dedicated customers observed reduced throughput and metric drift, and Private deployments running runtime-1.20 reported OOMs and token-level corruption due to an optimizer/kernel mismatch with the quantized weights. This ticket coordinates an interruptible hotpatch, cross-environment rollback gating, customer communication, and follow-ups to prevent recurrence.
technical_root_cause: Preliminary analysis indicates a kernel selection heuristic change in runtime-1.22 that prefers an experimental int8 fused attention kernel for sequences >2048. The kernel produces non-deterministic token logits in combination with a specific KV cache alignment used by the v3.1 model quantization pipeline. Hosted instances using the new routing policy diverted some traffic to a fallback 16-bit path, reducing impact; Dedicated and Private customers with pinned runtimes or hardware-specific kernels were exposed to the faulty path. The mismatch surfaced as increased perplexity and hallucination rates and occasional OOMs when cache growth paths mis-estimated memory for quantized tensors.

mitigation_plan:
Short-term (reach):
- Hotpatch: add runtime flag --force-attn-fp16 that bypasses experimental int8 fused attention kernel. Ship as runtime-1.22.1-hotfix.
- Immediate pin: for Dedicated accounts with enterprise pins, instruct account owners to pin to model v3.0 or runtime-1.21 until hotfix is validated.
- Private: provide signed hotfix package and assisted upgrade path; offer rollback script and memory checks.

Medium-term (1-2 sprints):
- Add deterministic unit tests for kernel/logit stability across quantized weight variants.
- Introduce a rollout gating rule: for model families with quantized variants, require A/B evaluation on representative long-context prompts across all deployment modes before >15% traffic ramp.
- Add runtime telemetry: expose kernel-selection histogram and per-kernel divergence score to Console tracing dashboards.

Long-term (quarter):
- Rework kernel-selection heuristic to include a stability score computed from model-specific evals.
- Expand continuous evals in Optimize to flag regressions pre-rollout.
